cues.en: (brief upbeat music)
cues.zh: （短暫輕快音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back, everyone.
cues.zh: 歡迎大家回來。

cues.en: In this lecture, we're going to discuss the difference between TensorFlow and Keras.
cues.zh: 本堂討論 TensorFlow 與 Keras 差別。

cues.en: So, before we begin learning how to code our own neural networks, I want to quickly clarify the differences between TensorFlow and Keras since this is a common point of confusion for students.
cues.zh: 寫自己的網路前，釐清這常見困惑。

cues.en: So, we already learned all the theoretical aspects of neural networks.
cues.zh: 已學完理論。

cues.en: Now, right before we start coding, I wanna clarify a few things.
cues.zh: 開始程式前再確認幾件事。

cues.en: TensorFlow is an open-source deep learning library developed by Google, with TensorFlow 2.0 being officially released in late 2019.
cues.zh: TensorFlow 是 Google 開發的開源深度學習函式庫，2.0 於2019年底正式發布。

cues.en: TensorFlow has a large ecosystem of related components, including libraries like Tensorboard for visualization, Deployment options, and Production APIs,
cues.zh: 相關生態龐大，包括 TensorBoard 視覺化、部署選項、生產 API，

cues.en: as well as support for various programming languages, not just Python.
cues.zh: 也支援不只 Python 的多種語言。

cues.en: Keras is a high-level Python library that can use a variety of deep learning libraries underneath.
cues.zh: Keras 是高階 Python 函式庫，底層能用不同深度學習庫。

cues.en: So, it can operate on top of libraries such as TensorFlow, CNTK, or Theano.
cues.zh: 能在 TensorFlow、CNTK、Theano 上運作。

cues.en: TensorFlow 1.x or any of the 1. versions had a complex Python class system for building models, and because it was a little more complex,
cues.zh: TensorFlow 1.x 建模的 Python 類別系統複雜，

cues.en: the Keras library ended up being a simpler, more abstract API that could run on top of TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 所以 Keras 成為其上更簡單、抽象化的 API。

cues.en: So Keras ended up becoming very popular, and it was so popular that when the developers for TensorFlow ended up releasing 2.0, they adopted Keras as the official API for TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 因此很受歡迎，TensorFlow 2.0 開發者採它作官方 API。

cues.en: So, while Keras still also remains as a separate library from TensorFlow, it can also now be officially imported through TensorFlow, so there's no need
cues.zh: 雖然仍可獨立於 TensorFlow，現在也能正式從 TensorFlow 匯入，不需要

cues.en: to do an additional installation of Keras.
cues.zh: 額外安裝 Keras。

cues.en: Keras is now officially part of TensorFlow and it's the official API for TensorFlow 2.0 and going forward because it's simpler to use than the more complex subclass system
cues.zh: 它是 TensorFlow 正式一部分、2.0 及後續官方 API，比先前複雜子類別系統

cues.en: that was used in TensorFlow 1.x versions.
cues.zh: 簡單。

cues.en: The Keras API is easy to use and build models by simply adding layers on top of each other through simple calls.
cues.zh: 只需簡單呼叫，一層疊一層就能建模型。

cues.en: So, in the next lecture, let's begin exploring the basics of the Keras API for TensorFlow.
cues.zh: 下一堂探索 TensorFlow Keras API 基礎。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
